title: adrix's better end
description: this project adds end update: biomes, structures and mobs.
body:
Guys, do you know the Better End mod? Perfect, because this mod will add similar stuff. Period, nothing else.The beta version works pretty well. If you find any bugs, don't hesitate to report them on my Discord.  
I hope you enjoy the mod!!

the discord:https://discord.gg/NNaS7sew
it's italian. but you can write in english

the mod add:
  a new biome called "The Eeneria biome"
  one boss called enduzz
    it is a puzzle man
  a few of new blocks
    -eeneriagrass
    -ancient endstone
  a new variant of the enderman "the eeneria enderman"
    idk its green?
for now its all
